• Article 243 – Definitions

• Article 243P – Municipalities

• Article 243ZE – Metropolitan Planning Committee

items: State Finance Commission (Article 243I) and State Election Commission (Article 243K) are frequently asked in Indian Polity MCQs.
Do not confuse District Planning Committee (243ZD) with Metropolitan Planning Committee (243ZE).
Article 243P specifically defines and introduces Municipalities.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Article 243 outlines the foundational definitions for local governance in India.
Article 243B mandates the constitution of Panchayats for rural local self-governance.
Articles 243I and 243K establish the State Finance Commission and State Election Commission respectively.
Article 243P marks the beginning of provisions related to Municipalities.
Articles 243ZD and 243ZE provide for District Planning Committees and Metropolitan Planning Committees.
